cumleler: How many decibels separate detecting speech from understanding it?
The speech detection threshold, SDT, is where speech is first noticed.
The speech recognition threshold, SRT, needs half the words correct.
Understanding takes more sound energy than just detecting.
So the SDT is usually about eight to ten decibels better.
The SDT helps young children who cannot do an SRT.
